import hashlib, sqlite3, tempfile, os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import user_auth

tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
path = os.path.join(tmp, "test.db")
conn = sqlite3.connect(path)
user_auth.init_db(conn)
ok = True

def check(label, cond):
    global ok
    print(("PASS" if cond else "FAIL"), "-", label)
    if not cond: ok = False

# register + authenticate
uid = user_auth.register_user(conn, "alice", "alice@example.com", "s3cret!")
check("register returns id", uid > 0)
user = user_auth.authenticate(conn, "alice", "s3cret!")
check("authenticate ok", user and user["email"] == "alice@example.com" and user["access_rights"] == "user")
check("wrong password rejected", user_auth.authenticate(conn, "alice", "wrong") is None)
check("unknown user rejected", user_auth.authenticate(conn, "nobody", "s3cret!") is None)

# duplicates / validation
try:
    user_auth.register_user(conn, "alice", "other@example.com", "password2"); check("dup username rejected", False)
except ValueError: check("dup username rejected", True)
try:
    user_auth.register_user(conn, "bob", "alice@example.com", "password2"); check("dup email rejected", False)
except ValueError: check("dup email rejected", True)
try:
    user_auth.register_user(conn, "bob", "bob@example.com", "short"); check("short password rejected", False)
except ValueError: check("short password rejected", True)

# new hash format is PBKDF2
row = conn.execute("SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE username='alice'").fetchone()
check("new hash is pbkdf2", row[0].startswith("pbkdf2_sha256$"))

# legacy sha256 hash still verifies
legacy = hashlib.sha256(b"legacypw").hexdigest()
conn.execute("INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, created_date) VALUES (?,?,?,date('now'))",
             ("frank", "frank@example.com", legacy))
conn.commit()
check("legacy hash authenticates", user_auth.authenticate(conn, "frank", "legacypw") is not None)
check("legacy wrong pw rejected", user_auth.authenticate(conn, "frank", "wrong") is None)

# admin upsert
first = user_auth.upsert_admin(conn)
second = user_auth.upsert_admin(conn)
row = conn.execute("SELECT access_rights FROM users WHERE username='dev_admin'").fetchone()
check("admin created with admin rights", row[0] == "admin")
check("admin upsert resets in place", first == second)
check("admin authenticates", user_auth.authenticate(conn, "dev_admin", "Password123!") is not None)

conn.close()
print("\nALL PASS" if ok else "\nSOME TESTS FAILED")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
EOF
